info.name: B2B Platform admin — live only
info.description:
# Platform admin — live routes only

Generated 2026-09-17 from route:list.
Import docs/api/environments/platform-web.postman_environment.json.
baseUrl is the host only. Seed: admin@platform.sy / password.
This is NOT the channel dashboard.

| Guard | `none` |
| Permission | `—` |
| Role | `—` |

🟡 Body {challenge_token, code}. Challenge 10 min / 5 attempts. Idempotency exempt.

**EP-AD-005** · stable

| Guard | `platform` |
| Permission | `—` |
| Role | `—` |

🟡 Opens a 15-minute window used only by PUT /platform/me/password. Replay the original write with the same key.

| Guard | `none` |
| Permission | `—` |
| Role | `—` |

🟡 Seeded admin has no 2FA → token. With 2FA: {requires_2fa, challenge_token}. Wrong credentials = generic 401. expires_at is nominal.

🟡 Identical to GET /platform/me.

**EP-AD-159B** · stable
